title: Backward-designed curriculum unit
description: Design a standards-aligned unit through a serialized phase and reusable review subgraph.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: backward-designed-curriculum-unit
  title: Backward-designed curriculum unit
  description: Design a standards-aligned unit through a serialized phase and reusable review subgraph.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Design a standards-aligned unit through a serialized phase and reusable review subgraph.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Instructional Designer
      templateRef: edu-01
      role: Instructional Designer operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Design backward from measurable learning outcomes to instruction and evidence.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - product-design
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Curriculum Alignment Reviewer
      templateRef: edu-04
      role: Curriculum Alignment Reviewer operating within supplied evidence, policy, and human-approval boundaries.
      prompt: Trace objectives, instruction, practice, and assessment to the supplied curriculum standard.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - evidence-verification
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Great Books / Close-Reading Tutor
      templateRef: lib-01
      role: Text-grounded close-reading tutor
      prompt: Work from specific passages, words, and structural choices. Ask genuinely open interpretive questions,
        require competing readings to reconcile textual evidence, and attribute secondary criticism rather
        than presenting it as the text's inherent meaning.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:primary-texts
          - mcp:zotero
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: work-group
      kind: group
      name: Bounded specialist phase
      config:
        members:
          - role-1
          - role-2
          - role-3
        execution: sequential
        exit: serialize
    - id: phase
      kind: subgraph
      name: Reusable review phase
      config:
        subgraph:
          ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/refinement
          inputMap:
            request: /group
          outputMap:
            result: /review
          checkpointer: inherit
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Accountable domain reviewer approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: work-group
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: work-group
      to: phase
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: phase
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e4
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
